No. It shows a management result, not a tax one. Your accounting office gets a package of the month’s invoices from you, and you know how the company is doing before the tax settlement comes.
Can my team see the company’s finances?
Nie. Pracownik widzi swój czas, urlopy i dokumenty. Faktury, przelewy i analiza są dla ról z dostępem do finansów.
No. An employee sees their own time, leave and documents. Invoices, transfers and analysis are for roles with access to finances.
How often is the data refreshed?
Faktury z KSeF co 2 godziny, przelewy z banku co drugi dzień. Godziny zespołu widać od razu.
Invoices from KSeF every 2 hours, bank transfers every other day. Team hours show up right away.
Czy mogę przenieść dane z obecnego programu?
Can I move my data from my current software?

Osobnego importu z innych programów nie ma. Po połączeniu z KSeF Firmowid sam pobiera faktury z ostatnich 30 dni, a bank udostępnia do 90 dni historii przelewów. Starsze faktury kosztowe dodasz jako PDF albo zdjęcie.

There is no separate import from other software. Once connected to KSeF, Firmowid fetches the invoices from the last 30 days on its own, and your bank shares up to 90 days of transfer history. You can add older cost invoices as a PDF or a photo.

Firmowid łączy się z 29 bankami i fintechami, między innymi PKO BP, Pekao, mBank, ING, Millennium, Alior, BNP Paribas, Revolut i Wise. Konto spoza listy dodasz ręcznie po numerze IBAN, bez synchronizacji.

Firmowid connects to 29 banks and fintechs, including PKO BP, Pekao, mBank, ING, Millennium, Alior, BNP Paribas, Revolut and Wise. You can add an account from outside the list by hand with its IBAN, without syncing.
Na serwerach OVH w Unii Europejskiej. Bank podłączasz tylko do odczytu, Firmowid nie zleca przelewów.
On OVH servers in the European Union. You connect your bank read-only, and Firmowid never makes transfers.

is run by Ania and Weronika. It is a small bookshop with a hand-picked selection of travel books. A café with good coffee, a wide choice of teas and craft beers, with and without alcohol. A place to meet travellers, with slide shows, book launches, concerts and exhibition openings.
